data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 雨停前的屋檐
data.description: 便利店的屋檐下，雪菜把还未打开的伞靠在身边，等雨势小一点再走。
data.action: standing under an awning with a closed umbrella
data.promptProse: Standing beneath the illuminated awning of a convenience store during an evening rain, Setsuna holds her closed umbrella beside her warm winter coat, calmly waiting for the shower to pass. Golden storefront lighting illuminates wet pavement reflections, glass door posters, and rain puddles glistening in the twilight.
